Evidence: Hindustan ka naam Mughals ne diya tha, jo Sindhu nadi ke naam se aata hai. Yeh naam sabhi logon ko shamil karta hai, na ki sirf Hinduo ko. Source 1 kehta hai ki Hindustan ka matlab sirf Hinduon ka desh nahi hai, balki yeh sabhi logon ka hai jo Bharat mein baste hain, jaise Muslims aur Christians. Hindi, jo ki ek pramukh bhasha hai, zyada tar Uttar Bharat mein boli jaati hai, lekin yeh desh ke anya hisson mein bhi suna jaata hai (Source 2). Hindi aur Urdu dono bhashaon ka ek samanya itihas hai, jo Hindu aur Muslim samudayon ke beech ek ekta ka prateek hai (Source 3).
Justification: Retrieved evidence se yeh saaf hai ki Hindustan ka naam sirf Hinduon se nahi, balki Mughals se aaya hai, jo is naam ko sabhi logon ke liye istemal karte the. Source 1 mein yeh spasht hai ki Hindustan ka matlab sirf Hinduon ka desh nahi hai, balki yeh sabhi dharmon ke logon ka hai. Isliye, claim ki mool baat ki Hindustan sirf Hinduon ka desh hai, yeh galat hai.
